_comment: V3 REDO (2026-09-11) -- the Nemotron tasks that did not survive the first v3 pass.
Same slug and output dirs as capture_nemotronv3: the previous dirs were moved to
shared/icr_capture/_superseded/<dir>.off<budget> before this was queued, so these
cells start clean (config.json records the budget and is only written when absent).
gsm8k    all 4 shards quarantined at 1024: off-truncation 24-28%, just over the 20% gate. 1024 -> 2048.
math500  shard00 quarantined at 21.6%; the other three averaged 16.5% at 2048, far from 'near zero'.
Whole task redone at 4096 so every shard has one budget.
mmlu_pro shards 00/02/03 died of CUDA OOM (a 65 GiB co-tenant on the GPU, not our batch);
the surviving shard was at 6.8% off-truncation. Whole task redone at 2048, batch 8.
Thinking-ON budgets unchanged, so the on-side stays comparable to the rest of v3.
name: capture_nemotronv3_redo
